purpose: Read-only statistical robustness audit on already materialized signed daily RankIC evidence.
label: forward_open_5d:v1 raw five-trading-day adjusted-open return
method: Calendar-month block bootstrap of signed daily RankIC. Each replicate samples observed month blocks with replacement, retaining all daily observations within each sampled block.

results.interpretation: The signed mean is robust to month-block resampling, but the interval is widest among the candidates and does not remove the separately observed weak-trend/high-volatility regime sensitivity.
Both train and validation intervals are comfortably above the signed mean threshold. Candidate-pair redundancy with Alpha405 remains the separate limitation.
The narrowest validation month-block confidence interval among the candidates, consistent with prior monthly and regime robustness evidence.
Train and validation month-block intervals remain above the signed mean threshold; retain the separately defined training high-volatility monitor.

decision: All four candidates retain a positive signed RankIC confidence interval and a 95% lower bound above 0.02 under the specified monthly block bootstrap. This validates mean-signal robustness only and does not supersede regime, similarity, formula, monthly-monitoring, or explicit-admission gates.
action: Do not alter the formal factor set, publish any factor, write factor values, add model inputs, or start model training based on this audit.
